name: Concept and design blueprint
required_evidence: Design docs, product hypotheses, honest scoreboard
exit_conditions: Founder commits to fund professional scopes (F-1, F-2); evidence plan agreed
go_hold_kill_questions: Is the founder willing to test before building?
today_note: Done: design docs, Core 5 food and beer hypotheses, planning docs. Not done: any cooking, tasting, brewing, quote, legal or professional review, customer contact. Evidence readiness 4/95.

name: Professional scoping and legal pathway
entry_conditions: S0 exit; F-1 budget band chosen
required_evidence: Texas alcohol attorney memo; IP attorney view on NASHA; head brewer and cultural advisor input (all by qualified professionals)
exit_conditions: Attorney confirms or rules out beer-food structures; name clearance outcome known
main_risks: Legal path blocks beer-linked ideas; name not clearable
go_hold_kill_questions: Does any lawful structure link food and beer before a brewery? Is NASHA clearable?
today_note: Observed: T1 web summaries only, attorney question list and trademark package drafted. Not done: no attorney or brewer engaged (F-2 READY, unactioned); clearance pending (F-5).

name: Founder kitchen prototype and blinded sensory
entry_conditions: S0 exit; recipes frozen for session (D-74 Chicken 65 Session 1 frozen)
required_evidence: Logged cook sessions with photos; blinded tasting notes; failure log
exit_conditions: Core 5 dishes pass pre-set pass rules or are cut or reworked
main_risks: Taster bias; home-kitchen results do not scale; D-54 derivative leaks (lard, stock)
go_hold_kill_questions: Do dishes taste intentional rather than gimmicky? Which dishes get cut?
today_note: Nothing has been cooked or tasted. Chicken 65 Session 1 is designed and frozen only.

name: Guest concept validation (private and small paid tastings)
entry_conditions: S2 exit; legal check on any charging or alcohol; thresholds frozen in advance
required_evidence: Structured interviews (target 30 per investor doc), tasting scores, willingness-to-pay responses, repeat-intent
exit_conditions: Thresholds met on pre-registered measures; else rework or kill
main_risks: Friendly-crowd bias; paid event legality; stated vs real intent
go_hold_kill_questions: Do strangers want it and pay? Is demand from beyond friends?
today_note: Zero interviews. Thresholds are TBD and must be founder-set before running.

name: Pilot beer and brewery partnership
entry_conditions: S1 legal view; brewer engaged (F-2, F-3)
required_evidence: Brewer-designed pilot results; partner brewery interest in writing; food x beer session notes
exit_conditions: Pilot beers meet brewer's quality bar; at least one partner structure is lawful and acceptable
main_risks: Beer thesis unproven; partner unwilling; license limits
go_hold_kill_questions: Does beer add enough value to justify its complexity? Is the partner path real?
today_note: Blocked on F-2/F-3 (no brewer or attorney engaged). No beer brewed, no partner contacted.

name: Pop-ups and brewery residency (repeat events)
entry_conditions: S3 exit; legal clearance for the event form; host or commissary identified
required_evidence: Per-event traction log (TRACTION-METRICS), repeat visitors, contribution per session, ticket times
exit_conditions: Repeat demand and unit economics clear frozen thresholds across several events
main_risks: Event novelty inflates data; host terms; permit surprises
go_hold_kill_questions: Do guests return? Does a session make positive contribution?
today_note: No events; traction log empty. G-13 OPEN.

name: Mobile or commissary operation (trailer decision)
entry_conditions: S5 exit; stable menu; permit and commissary path verified with authorities
required_evidence: Weeks of repeat sales data, cost per portion, supply stability for goat, permit status
exit_conditions: Go or no-go on an owned asset based on repeat evidence and margin
main_risks: Asset commitment, permits, no alcohol sales from unit, operator burnout
go_hold_kill_questions: Is an owned asset justified over continued rented-kitchen events?
today_note: Depends on S5. Cost figures in repo are national T3 only, not quotes.

name: Proven brand and capital readiness
entry_conditions: S5 or S6 results; named advisors; counsel clears solicitation rules
required_evidence: Investor proof package at traction level, financial model at M3 or above, trademark status, risk register with owners
exit_conditions: Capital conversations backed by evidence; or decision to stay small
go_hold_kill_questions: Is the evidence strong enough to ask others for money?
today_note: No investor identified or contacted. Financial model has blank inputs.

name: Compact permanent site or larger validation step
entry_conditions: S7 exit; licence structure memo (G-11); site geography (G-10); brewer plan
required_evidence: Costed plan from architect and brewer, site economics, license pathway
exit_conditions: Fixed-site economics proven at small scale, or flagship plan revised
main_risks: Lease and equipment lock-in; licensing delay
go_hold_kill_questions: Does a fixed site beat continued residency? Is brewing on site justified?
today_note: Optional rung; may be skipped or combined with flagship.

name: Flagship brewery and kitchen
entry_conditions: All prior gates met at evidence level 3 or above; costed design; funded
required_evidence: Full proof package, quoted construction and equipment, license in hand, team
main_risks: Capital at risk; unproven pairing thesis; cost overrun
go_hold_kill_questions: Does everything in the proof package hold at flagship scale?

name: Expansion (hypothesis only)
required_evidence: Repeatable operating model, second-site or licensing economics
main_risks: Dilution of brand and cultural integrity
go_hold_kill_questions: Is the model repeatable without the founder?
today_note: Not designed; deliberately undefined until single-site proof exists.
